plain_english_policy: Focus on expanding pre-kindergarten access and vocational training programs, funded by reallocating state budget from non-essential administrative costs.
evidence_quote: My top priorities will be **universal pre-K for all four-year-olds**—backed by redirecting funds from bloated bureaucratic overhead—and **expanding workforce development partnerships with community colleges**, ensuring no student graduates with debt for critical trade skills. We’ll also push for a 10% corporate tax on untaxed digital revenue to fund these programs without raising personal income taxes.
review_reason: The option combines progressive education goals (pre-K, debt-free vocational training) with a mixed funding mechanism (redirected overhead + new corporate tax). The tax proposal leans progressive but may lack stable left/right alignment due to procedural reallocation.
